title: Early-Settlement Discount on Universal Life Insurance Loan Interest
content:
**What reduces loan interest settled early on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy?** The early-settlement discount. It follows the number of monthly anniversaries still to fall due after the settlement date up to and including the next policy anniversary, when the interest would otherwise fall due.

**What are the bands?**

| Monthly anniversaries remaining after the settlement date, through the next policy anniversary | Discount on the accrued settlement interest |
|---|---|
| 6 or more (the full-discount number) | Full early-settlement discount, **2%** (0.02) |
| 3, 4 or 5 (at least the partial-discount number of 3, fewer than 6) | Partial early-settlement discount, **1%** (0.01) |
| Fewer than 3 | No discount |

**How is the discount applied?** Once, to the accrued settlement interest figured from the counted days and rates: the interest is reduced by 2% or 1% of itself before it is rounded to the cent. No intermediate figure is rounded.

**How are the remaining monthly anniversaries counted? (hypothetical, issue date 15 January, monthly anniversaries on the 15th)** A monthly anniversary falling on the settlement date itself is not counted; the next policy anniversary, 15 January, is counted.

| Settlement date | Monthly anniversaries remaining | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 20 June | 7 (15 July through 15 January) | 2% |
| 15 July | 6 (15 August through 15 January) | 2% |
| 16 August | 5 | 1% |
| 15 October | 3 | 1% |
| 20 November | 2 | None |

**What does it come to? (hypothetical)** Accrued settlement interest of $595.0685 with 7 monthly anniversaries remaining is reduced by 2% to $583.1671 and settled at $583.17; with 4 remaining it is reduced by 1% to $589.1178 and settled at $589.12; with 2 remaining it is settled at $595.07.
